s0501.literal: Fifty thousand shi of grain were granted to the households under Princes Yuemuhu'er and Ulus Hubuhua;
s0501.idiomatic: 50,000 shi of grain were granted to the households under Princes Yuemuhu'er and Ulus Hubuhua;

s0502.literal: seven hundred crane controllers were granted five hundred ingots of notes.
s0502.idiomatic: 700 crane controllers were granted 500 ingots of notes.

s0503.literal: Eleventh month, gengyin day: Annam presented local products as tribute.
s0503.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin day, Annam presented local products as tribute.

s0504.literal: On bingshen day Director of the Privy Council Na Huai said: "For routine documents, we request that deputy privy council directors and below be authorized to sign and dispatch them.
s0504.idiomatic: On bingshen day director of the privy council Na Huai said, "For routine documents, we request that deputy privy council directors and below be authorized to sign and dispatch them.

s0506.literal: The Yunnan branch censorate was abolished and a rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commission was established.
s0506.idiomatic: The Yunnan branch censorate was abolished and a rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commission was established.

s0507.literal: On jihai day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0507.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0508.literal: On xinchou day Mercury transgressed Ox.
s0508.idiomatic: On xinchou day Mercury transgressed Ox.

s0509.literal: The remittance of interest money submitted by the Xu and Pi smelting offices was abolished.
s0509.idiomatic: The remittance of interest money submitted by the Xu and Pi smelting offices was abolished.

s0510.literal: On renyin day the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.
s0510.idiomatic: On renyin day the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.

s0511.literal: Wang Qingduan, right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, was made grand councillor.
s0511.idiomatic: Wang Qingduan, right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, was made grand councillor.

s0512.literal: Six thousand bolts of cloth were granted to Karakorum military officers, with clothing, hats, and other goods in varying amounts.
s0512.idiomatic: 6,000 bolts of cloth were granted to Karakorum military officers, with clothing, hats, and other goods in varying amounts.

s0513.literal: Twelfth month, wuwu day: Venus crossed the sky.
s0513.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuwu day, Venus crossed the sky.

s0514.literal: On jiwei day Saturn transgressed Ghost.
s0514.idiomatic: On jiwei day Saturn transgressed Ghost.

s0515.literal: On yichou day Venus transgressed Jupiter, and the moon transgressed Mars.
s0515.idiomatic: On yichou day Venus transgressed Jupiter, and the moon transgressed Mars.

s0516.literal: Horses on all routes were registered and requisitioned; except pregnant mares with foals at side, all three years of age and above were confiscated.
s0516.idiomatic: Horses on all routes were registered and requisitioned; except pregnant mares with foals at side, all three years of age and above were confiscated.

s0517.literal: Eight hundred fifty thousand ingots of notes were granted to the household under Duo Erduo Hai.
s0517.idiomatic: 850,000 ingots of notes were granted to the household under Duo Erduo Hai.

s0518.literal: On gengwu day Saturn entered Ghost, and the moon transgressed Upper General.
s0518.idiomatic: On gengwu day Saturn entered Ghost, and the moon transgressed Upper General.

s0519.literal: On xinwei day additional reviewing officials were established on each route, exclusively in charge of criminal cases; two on upper routes, one on lower routes.
s0519.idiomatic: On xinwei day additional reviewing officials were established on each route, exclusively in charge of criminal cases; two on upper routes, one on lower routes.

s0520.literal: An edict directed that fugitive soldiers who returned to their occupations were exempt from corvée for three years.
s0520.idiomatic: An edict directed that fugitive soldiers who returned to their occupations were exempt from corvée for three years.

s0521.literal: Darqan, branch secretariat grand councillor of Jiang-Zhe, was promoted to left chancellor.
s0521.idiomatic: Darqan, branch secretariat grand councillor of Jiang-Zhe, was promoted to left chancellor.

s0522.literal: On jiaxu day a comet appeared below the Children and Grandchildren Star.
s0522.idiomatic: On jiaxu day a comet appeared below the Children and Grandchildren Star.

s0523.literal: On jimao day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.
s0523.idiomatic: On jimao day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.

s0524.literal: On xinsi day rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commissions were ordered each year to recommend two upright and capable men from their jurisdictions.
s0524.idiomatic: On xinsi day rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commissions were ordered each year to recommend two upright and capable men from their jurisdictions.

s0525.literal: An edict directed that government-market purchase pay fair market price promptly to the owners; violators were punished.
s0525.idiomatic: An edict directed that government-market purchase pay fair market price promptly to the owners; violators were punished.

s0526.literal: Commercial taxes were fixed at one in thirty; the annual quota was not to be increased.
s0526.idiomatic: Commercial taxes were fixed at one in thirty; the annual quota was not to be increased.

s0527.literal: Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered drought and locusts; one hundred thousand shi of grain were granted for relief.
s0527.idiomatic: Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered drought and locusts; 100,000 shi of grain were granted for relief.

s0528.literal: Wives and children of soldiers killed in battle were supplied with clothing and grain.
s0528.idiomatic: Wives and children of soldiers killed in battle were supplied with clothing and grain.

s0529.literal: Taxes of the inner commanderies were remitted.
s0529.idiomatic: Taxes of the inner commanderies were remitted.

s0530.literal: More than three hundred households under Prince Xiao Xue were scattered at Fengxiang; two thousand eight hundred qing of fields in Lu Prefecture were granted to them.
s0530.idiomatic: More than 300 households under Prince Xiao Xue were scattered at Fengxiang; 2,800 qing of fields in Lu Prefecture were granted to them.

s0531.literal: Two hundred nineteen prisoners in the capital were released.
s0531.idiomatic: 219 prisoners in the capital were released.
